rawContent: Over the past few years we have seen the power of survivors discovering that other survivors have come forward to report an abuser. Knowing that they are not the alone gives them the strength to have their voice heard. #MeToo has been a powerful movement against untouchable.

However, we must also be mindful of the power imbalance between a sexual predator & their prey. Especially when the predator is in power. It can be terrifying for 1 or 2 survivors to share their story alone. When significant #metoo stories are shared there’s no hiding the truth.
This is disgraceful. Even a charge for common assault & a ban from public transport would be lenient! #keyworkers deserve more. #BlackLivesMatter #COVIDIDIOTS #coronavirus #Corona_Spitters

@johnnybev1987 @aDatingDad @BorisJohnson @Number10press I disagree Johnny. This is a reason why the American #police think they can get away with the increased #brutality right now. They think everyone is distracted with #covid19 but making a statement that British people are concerned about #BlackLivesMatter will take a few mins.

@jessphillips Did you see how Boris looked down as discussed #racism & #BlackLivesMatter ? He couldn’t look anyone in the eye! Either because he was saying what he should say, rather than what he believes or because he knows his own Gov are responsible for institutional racism. Probably both!

@treventoursu @UniNorthants They should also care about the lives of their black students, especially when some are from USA! Companies like @MyUNiDAYS have supported #BlackLivesMatter so it’s the least that @UniNorthants can do. You shouldn’t need to ask them. They should just do it because it’s right.

@melaniecrofts @treventour I can highly recommend these talks by Professor Lesley Thomas QC. The dates are in the main article. share them with colleagues at Uni Northants & DMU etc. 😊 #PoliceBrutalityuk #BlackLivesMatter #deathsincustody

You can contact me or @NorthantsREC to borrow @RaceAct40 mobile exhibition resources. The easy to use pull-ups can be used in schools, universities, workplaces & community events etc. The Project may have ended but the resources remain available #BlackLivesMatter #standuptoracism

@nadinebh_ Disgraceful! EDL & co shared islamophobic hate speech and caused trouble for years all around the country while hiding behind their right to protest. Then when people protest peacefully for #BlackLivesMatter they are antagonised & treated like criminals & troublemakers.

The moment we #protest for something meaningful & just which will threaten power & capitalism the State feels threatened & quickly results to various tactics to obstruct PEACEFUL protests. We always see it with #BlackLivesMatter & environmental protests like #ExtinctionRebellion

@gmpolice Rubbish! You don’t even stand with your own black officers when they are subjected to racism by their colleagues! You can’t pretend GMP are tolerant & respect #BlackLivesMatter when your own black officer was #ForcedOut (read the book) because of toxic police racism & homophobia!

The truth is that we now live in a time where we CAN break down these unjust structures that promote racism & all other forms of discrimination. We can do it if we do it together! We don’t need the States permission for an equal society where #BlackLivesMatter

@SarahForshaw1 Yes, I have no doubt that there are some people joining #BlackLivesMatter hype because they think it’s something cool that will get them a few likes, like a superficial Insta pic but there are many people who do care, who are affected & who live with racial discrimination!

I see Tommy R is back out the woodwork & has shifted his attention away from islamophobia to denying racism exists, saying Trump is the greatest president to live & turning on #BlackLivesMatter protests. I wonder who his next target will be? Maybe Monks or Jewish communities?
